# checkout-kit

> The first production-grade Go SaaS starter kit with Stripe checkout, RBAC, admin dashboard, and S3 image upload. Node backend and Tailwind frontend also included. One purchase, two backend editions, two frontend flavors.

checkout-kit is a full-stack React starter kit for building Stripe-powered storefronts. It ships a public product catalog, a currency-locked cart, a 3-step Stripe checkout wizard (Elements + Setup Intent), order management, a Stripe webhook handler, a field-level RBAC engine, and an admin dashboard with a sales chart and S3 drag-drop image upload.

Two backend editions: Go (Gin + MongoDB, premium) and Node (Express + MongoDB, accessible). Two frontend flavors per edition: MUI v9 (Material Design, dark mode) and Tailwind CSS. All four combinations share the same API contracts, the same Stripe flow, and the same 43-file Bruno API collection.

MongoDB ships by default. PostgreSQL is available free on request for any edition.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs): Overview, feature list, stack, and quick-start for all four kit flavors.
- [Installation](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/installation): Step-by-step setup for Go or Node backend, MUI or Tailwind frontend, environment variables, Stripe CLI webhook forwarding.
- [Architecture](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/architecture): Project layout for Go and Node editions, folder conventions, module boundaries.
- [MUI vs Tailwind](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/mui-vs-tailwind): Feature parity table, design token comparison, when to pick each flavor.
- [Provider Pattern](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/provider-pattern): Per-domain live/mock provider pattern — develop the full frontend without a running server.
- [RBAC Engine](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/rbac): Role-based access control with role inheritance, field-level permissions, and the Can component.
- [Theme & Tokens](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/theme): DashForge design tokens, dark mode implementation, MUI theme extension.
- [Catalog](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/catalog): Public storefront — product grid, search, slug-based product detail page.
- [Stripe Checkout](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/checkout): 3-step Stripe wizard using Elements and Setup Intent, cart lock, idempotency key strategy.
- [Cart & Orders](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/cart-orders): Currency-locked cart, immutable order snapshot at checkout, orders list.
- [Products CRUD](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/admin-products): Admin product form (Create/Edit shared), S3 cover + gallery upload, sales read-only via RBAC.
- [Dashboard](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/admin-dashboard): Sales chart (Recharts AreaChart), top products, recent activity feed — all from one /v1/admin/orders fetch.
- [Bruno Collection](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/bruno): 43-file Bruno API collection covering all 33 endpoints — auth, products, cart, checkout, orders, webhooks.
- [API Endpoints](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/api-endpoints): Full endpoint reference for Go and Node editions — method, path, auth, request/response shapes.
- [Stripe Webhook](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/webhook): Webhook handler for payment_intent.succeeded / payment_failed / charge.refunded, idempotency, signature verification.
- [Deploy to DigitalOcean](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/deployment): Step-by-step deployment guide for DO App Platform (managed PaaS) and Droplet (VPS + nginx + certbot). Covers Go and Node editions.
- [Production Checklist](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/production): Environment variables, CORS, Stripe live keys, S3 bucket policy, MongoDB Atlas, deployment options.
- [Pricing](https://checkout-kit.dashforge-ui.com/docs/pricing): License tiers for Go Edition (Developer $399, Team $899, Extended $1999) and Node Edition (Developer $299, Team $699, Extended $1499). One-time purchase. Team includes 2h implementation support. Extended includes 4h implementation support and white-label rights.

## Tech Stack

**Frontend (both editions):** React 19, Vite 5, Valtio (state), Zod (validation), React Router v6, React Hook Form. MUI flavor adds MUI v9 + DashForge theme tokens + dark mode. Tailwind flavor adds Tailwind CSS v4 + DashForge Tailwind tokens.

**Go Edition backend:** Go 1.24, Gin, MongoDB driver (no ORM), JWT + bcrypt, Stripe Go SDK, AWS SDK v2 (S3-compatible).

**Node Edition backend:** Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Mongoose, JWT + bcrypt, Stripe Node SDK, AWS SDK v3 (S3-compatible).

**Testing:** 314 Vitest cases (mock + live + mapper layers), Bruno collection for API testing.

- Extended: $1,999 — unlimited developers, unlimited deploys, white-label rights, SLA support, 4h implementation support (dedicated sessions)

Node Edition — one-time purchase, no subscription:
